title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1300 Main Street in Belmar, New Jersey, as the "Dr. Walter S. McAfee Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1300 Main Street in Belmar, New Jersey, as the "Dr. Walter S. McAfee Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renamed the Belmar, New Jersey post office at 1300 Main Street after Dr. Walter S. McAfee.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service building at 1300 Main Street in Belmar, New Jersey, the "Dr. Walter S. McAfee Post Office Building." It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 23, 2018.
